steps.en: Run the installer and pick the skills, the scope and the agents you use
steps.zh: 运行安装器，选 skill、安装范围和你用的 agent

steps.en: Copies the skill folders into each agent's skills dir and appends a pointer block to the entry file
steps.zh: 把 skill 拷进各 agent 的目录，在入口文件末尾追加指针块

component.en: pointer block in the entry file

steps.en: In a new session, give the UI, copy or comment task and answer During or After
steps.zh: 新开会话，交代 UI、文案或注释任务，回答 During 还是 After

steps.en: Loads the core plus the matching skill and applies the 38 rules while it builds
steps.zh: 加载核心和对应 skill，边写边套用 38 条规则

steps.en: Before handing over, writes a PASS/FAIL Delivery Gate report with evidence for every item
steps.zh: 交付前写出逐项带证据的 PASS/FAIL 交付闸门报告

value.en: You stop combing agent output by hand for invented stats, dead buttons and fake testimonials: the agent has to report each check
value.zh: 不用再手动翻 agent 产出找编造的数字、死按钮和假评价：agent 必须逐项交代检查结果
